statement: mu=1 uniform bidding is conversion-, revenue- and welfare-maximizing for tCPA in FPA (Theorem 5.2); welfare monotonicity follows as Corollary 5.3 when v_i=t_i.
method: Revenue(Rev=mu*base) monotonicity in mu; welfare computed as sum_C w_C max_i t_i p_i,C; welfare-monotonicity stress test over refined model pairs.

feasibility_and_revenue.note: CPA per won cluster = mu*t_i, so mu<=1 feasible; mu=1 binds the CPA constraint and maximizes revenue.

mu_below_one.description: mu=0.5 yields strictly lower revenue than mu=1.

value_not_equal_target.description: Set v_i != t_i; Welfare != Revenue, so the Corollary-5.3 premise (Welfare==Revenue) breaks.
